## What’s new

- Clubs adapt transfer and loan recruitment to season results, with strategies retained when you save and reload.
- Spending the transfer budget no longer puts a financially healthy club into crisis mode.
- Rebuilding clubs can recover after stronger results; facility influence stays balanced and incomplete league records no longer distort strategy reviews.
- Safer autosaving keeps later squad, contract and Inbox decisions marked for saving.
- Academy Challenge eligibility checks actual birthdays and excludes invalid dates and retired players.
- Fixed in-game patch history so each version shows its own updates.
- Updated the compact What’s New summary in all 12 supported languages.

Android ARM64 · Version 0.6.2 · Build 338

Install the APK over your existing OFMtouch app to keep your saves. Matching source and SHA-256 checksums are included.

Thank you for playing, testing and sharing feedback — TranquilMT.
